# Grants.gov Opportunities — Grants.gov Finder

> Federal grant opportunities from the official Grants.gov search2 API. Keyword, agency, posted-within and date filters to flat FOA JSON.

## Use it
- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/publicrecords~grants-gov-scraper/runs

## Claims you can rely on
- official Grants.gov search2 API
- flat deduplicated FOA rows
- keyword, agency, posted-within, and date filters
- opportunity identifiers, status, CFDA/ALN codes
- optional synopsis and funding-instrument hydration
